hints.content: Both $~~\displaystyle\sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty }(-1)^n2^{\frac{1}{n}}~~$ and $~~\displaystyle\sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty }2^{\frac{1}{n}}$ diverge, since $~2^{\frac1n}~$ $-$ the $~n$th root of $~2~$ $-$ approaches $~1\,$, not $~0\,$. The $~n$th Term Test says that if the terms of a series do not approach $~0\,$, then the series diverges.
